title: Dog Catches a Flying Frisbee
tests: Tests text-to-video generation of one readable action with a visible, physically coherent catch in a single shot.

faults.what: The camera does not stay stationary: the background trees shift substantially left as the framing follows the dog to the right.

judge.summary: A realistic golden retriever catches an identifiable red frisbee in a grassy park, but the camera moves instead of remaining fixed.

must_haves.item: A realistic golden retriever is visible in a grassy park.
must_haves.why: The dog has recognizable golden-retriever features and appears in a realistic grassy park with trees.

must_haves.item: A red frisbee visibly travels toward the dog before being caught in its mouth.
must_haves.why: The red frisbee is airborne ahead of the dog in the first frame and held in its mouth in subsequent frames.

must_haves.item: The frisbee remains identifiable through the catch rather than disappearing or passing through the dog.
must_haves.why: The red disc remains clearly recognizable at the dog's mouth after the catch.

must_haves.item: The five-second widescreen clip is one continuous shot with a stationary camera.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is five seconds and widescreen, and the frames appear to depict one continuous shot, but substantial background displacement shows camera movement.
Audio cannot be assessed from the supplied still frames.
